verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר וֶאֱמֶ֤ת הַדָּבָר֙ וְצָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּבִין֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר וּבִ֥ינָה ל֖וֹ בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šā·lō·wōš lə·ḵō·w·reš me·leḵ pā·ras dā·ḇār niḡ·lāh lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ’ă·šer- niq·rā šə·mōw bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar we·’ĕ·meṯ had·dā·ḇār wə·ṣā·ḇā ḡā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇîn ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ū·ḇî·nāh lōw bam·mar·’eh
verses.literal: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel who was called . . . Belteshazzar The message was true and it concerned a great conflict And the understanding of the message was given to him in a vision
verses.literalPt: NO terceiro ano de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, foi revelada uma palavra a Daniel, cujo nome era Beltessazar; a palavra era verdadeira e envolvia grande conflito; e ele entendeu esta palavra, e tinha entendimento da visão.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl hā·yî·ṯî miṯ·’ab·bêl šə·lō·šāh šā·ḇu·‘îm yā·mîm
verses.literal: In those days I Daniel was mourning for three full weeks
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias eu, Daniel, estive triste por três semanas.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּבָשָׂ֥ר וָיַ֛יִן לֹא־ בָ֥א אֶל־ פִּ֖י וְס֣וֹךְ לֹא־ סָ֑כְתִּי עַד־ מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ lō ’ā·ḵal·tî ū·ḇā·śār wā·ya·yin lō- ḇā ’el- pî wə·sō·wḵ lō- sā·ḵə·tî ‘aḏ- mə·lōṯ šə·lō·šeṯ šā·ḇu·‘îm yā·mîm
verses.literal: I ate no rich food no meat or wine entered . . . my mouth and I did not anoint myself with oil . . . until the three weeks . . . were completed
verses.literalPt: Alimento desejável não comi, nem carne nem vinho entraram na minha boca, nem me ungi com ungüento, até que se cumpriram as três semanas.

verses.original: וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַנָּהָ֛ר הַגָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî ‘al yaḏ han·nā·hār hag·gā·ḏō·wl hū ḥid·dā·qel
verses.literal: On the twenty-fourth . . . day of the first month as I was standing on the bank of the great . . . river the Tigris
verses.literalPt: E no dia vinte e quatro do primeiro mês eu estava à borda do grande rio Hidequel;

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־ עֵינַי֙ וָאֵ֔רֶא וְהִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּמָתְנָ֥יו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּכֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ê·nay wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ lā·ḇūš bad·dîm ū·mā·ṯə·nāw ḥă·ḡu·rîm bə·ḵe·ṯem ’ū·p̄āz
verses.literal: I lifted up my eyes and behold there was a certain man dressed in linen with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist
verses.literalPt: E levantei os meus olhos, e olhei, e eis um homem vestido de linho, e os seus lombos cingidos com ouro fino de Ufaz;

verses.original: וּגְוִיָּת֣וֹ כְתַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּפָנָ֞יו כְּמַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְעֵינָיו֙ כְּלַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו֙ וּמַרְגְּלֹתָ֔יו כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖יו כְּק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·wî·yā·ṯōw ḵə·ṯar·šîš ū·p̄ā·nāw kə·mar·’êh ḇā·rāq wə·‘ê·nāw kə·lap·pî·ḏê ’êš ū·zə·rō·‘ō·ṯāw ū·mar·gə·lō·ṯāw kə·‘ên nə·ḥō·šeṯ qā·lāl wə·qō·wl də·ḇā·rāw kə·qō·wl hā·mō·wn
verses.literal: His body was like beryl his face like the brilliance of lightning his eyes like flaming torches his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze and his voice like the sound of a multitude
verses.literalPt: E o seu corpo era como berilo, e o seu rosto parecia um relâmpago, e os seus olhos como tochas de fogo, e os seus braços e os seus pés brilhavam como bronze polido; e a voz das suas palavras era como a voz de uma multidão.

verses.original: וְרָאִיתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְבַדִּי֙ אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַֽיִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּהֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯî ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl lə·ḇad·dî ’eṯ- ham·mar·’āh wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘im·mî lō rā·’ū ’eṯ- ham·mar·’āh ’ă·ḇāl ḥă·rā·ḏāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh nā·p̄ə·lāh ‘ă·lê·hem way·yiḇ·rə·ḥū bə·hê·ḥā·ḇê
verses.literal: Only I Daniel saw the vision the men - with me did not see it - but a great terror fell upon them and they ran and hid themselves
verses.literalPt: E só eu, Daniel, tive aquela visão. Os homens que estavam comigo não a viram; contudo caiu sobre eles um grande temor, e fugiram, escondendo-se.

verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר־ בִּ֖י כֹּ֑ח וְהוֹדִ֗י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî niš·’ar·tî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’er·’eh ’eṯ- ham·mar·’āh hag·gə·ḏō·lāh haz·zōṯ wə·lō niš·’ar- bî kōḥ wə·hō·w·ḏî neh·paḵ ‘ā·lay lə·maš·ḥîṯ wə·lō ‘ā·ṣar·tî kō·aḥ
verses.literal: So I was left alone . . . gazing at this great vision No strength remained in me my face grew . . . deathly pale and I was powerless . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Fiquei, pois, eu só, a contemplar esta grande visão, e não ficou força em mim; transmudou-se o meu semblante em corrupção, e não tive força alguma.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑יו וּכְשָׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔יו וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל־ פָּנַ֖י וּפָנַ֥י אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl də·ḇā·rāw ū·ḵə·šā·mə·‘î ’eṯ- qō·wl də·ḇā·rāw wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî nir·dām ‘al- pā·nay ū·p̄ā·nay ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: I heard the sound of his words and as I listened - I . . . fell into a deep sleep . . . with my face . . . to the ground
verses.literalPt: Contudo ouvi a voz das suas palavras; e, ouvindo o som das suas palavras, eu caí sobre o meu rosto num profundo sono, com o meu rosto em terra.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־ יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑י וַתְּנִיעֵ֥נִי עַל־ בִּרְכַּ֖י וְכַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- yāḏ nā·ḡə·‘āh bî wat·tə·nî·‘ê·nî ‘al- bir·kay wə·ḵap·pō·wṯ yā·ḏāy
verses.literal: Suddenly a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands . . . and knees
verses.literalPt: E eis que certa mão me tocou, e fez com que me movesse sobre os meus joelhos e sobre as palmas das minhas mãos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ־ חֲ֠מֻדוֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־ עָמְדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑יךָ וּבְדַבְּר֥וֹ עִמִּ֛י אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay dā·nî·yêl ’îš- ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ hā·ḇên bad·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ḏō·ḇêr ’ê·le·ḵā wa·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏe·ḵā kî ‘at·tāh šul·laḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḏab·bə·rōw ‘im·mî ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ‘ā·maḏ·tî mar·‘îḏ
verses.literal: He said to me Daniel you are a man who is highly precious Consider carefully the words that I am about to say to you Stand up . . . . . . for I have now been sent to you And when he had said this to me . . . I stood up trembling
verses.literalPt: E me disse: Daniel, homem muito amado, entende as palavras que vou te dizer, e levanta-te sobre os teus pés, porque a ti sou enviado. E, falando ele comigo esta palavra, levantei-me tremendo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י׀ מִן־ הַיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת־ לִבְּךָ֛ לְהָבִ֧ין וּלְהִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑יךָ וַאֲנִי־ בָ֖אתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ’al- tî·rā ḏā·nî·yêl kî min- hay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn ’ă·šer nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- lib·bə·ḵā lə·hā·ḇîn ū·lə·hiṯ·‘an·nō·wṯ lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā niš·mə·‘ū ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā wa·’ă·nî- ḇā·ṯî biḏ·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not be afraid Daniel he said for from the first day that you purposed - to understand and to humble yourself before your God your words were heard and I have come in response to them
verses.literalPt: Então me disse: Não temas, Daniel, porque desde o primeiro dia em que aplicaste o teu coração a compreender e a humilhar-te perante o teu Deus, são ouvidas as tuas palavras; e eu vim por causa das tuas palavras.

verses.original: וְשַׂ֣ר׀ מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְנֶגְדִּי֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַשָּׂרִ֥ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי וַאֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śar mal·ḵūṯ pā·ras ‘ō·mêḏ lə·neḡ·dî ‘eś·rîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ yō·wm wə·hin·nêh mî·ḵā·’êl ’a·ḥaḏ haś·śā·rîm hā·ri·šō·nîm bā lə·‘ā·zə·rê·nî wa·’ă·nî nō·w·ṯar·tî šām ’ê·ṣel mal·ḵê p̄ā·rās
verses.literal: However, the prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me for twenty-one . . . days . . . Then Michael one of the chief princes came to help me for I had been left there with the kings of Persia
verses.literalPt: Mas o príncipe do reino da Pérsia me resistiu vinte e um dias, e eis que Miguel, um dos primeiros príncipes, veio para ajudar-me, e eu fiquei ali com os reis da Pérsia.

verses.original: וּבָ֙אתִי֙ לַהֲבִ֣ינְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֑ים כִּי־ ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṯî la·hă·ḇî·nə·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiq·rāh lə·‘am·mə·ḵā bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm kî- ‘ō·wḏ ḥā·zō·wn lay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the latter days for . . . the vision concerns those days
verses.literalPt: Agora vim, para fazer-te entender o que há de acontecer ao teu povo nos derradeiros dias; porque a visão é ainda para muitos dias.

verses.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛י אַ֖רְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḏab·bə·rōw ‘im·mî kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh nā·ṯat·tî p̄ā·nay ’ar·ṣāh wə·ne·’ĕ·lā·mə·tî
verses.literal: While he was speaking these words to me I set my face toward the ground and became speechless
verses.literalPt: E, falando ele comigo estas palavras, abaixei o meu rosto para a terra, e emudeci.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כִּדְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל־ שְׂפָתָ֑י וָאֶפְתַּח־ פִּ֗י וָאֲדַבְּרָה֙ וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ אֶל־ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדִּ֔י אֲדֹנִ֗י בַּמַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַי֙ עָלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh kiḏ·mūṯ bə·nê ’ā·ḏām nō·ḡê·a‘ ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯāy wā·’ep̄·taḥ- pî wā·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh wā·’ō·mə·rāh ’el- hā·‘ō·mêḏ lə·neḡ·dî ’ă·ḏō·nî bam·mar·’āh ne·hep̄·ḵū ṣî·ray ‘ā·lay wə·lō ‘ā·ṣar·tî kō·aḥ
verses.literal: And suddenly one with the likeness of a man touched . . . my lips and I opened my mouth . . . and said to the one standing before me My lord because of the vision I am overcome with anguish . . . and I have no strength
verses.literalPt: E eis que alguém, semelhante aos filhos dos homens, tocou-me os lábios; então abri a minha boca, e falei, dizendo àquele que estava em pé diante de mim: SENHOR meu, por causa da visão sobrevieram-me dores, e não me ficou força alguma.

verses.original: וְהֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִי֙ זֶ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר עִם־ אֲדֹ֣נִי זֶ֑ה וַאֲנִ֤י מֵעַ֙תָּה֙ לֹֽא־ יַעֲמָד־ בִּ֣י כֹ֔חַ וּנְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêḵ yū·ḵal ‘e·ḇeḏ ’ă·ḏō·nî zeh lə·ḏab·bêr ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nî zeh wa·’ă·nî mê·‘at·tāh lō- ya·‘ă·māḏ- bî ḵō·aḥ ū·nə·šā·māh lō niš·’ă·rāh- ḇî
verses.literal: How can I your . . . servant speak with you my lord Now I have no strength nor is any breath left in me
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, pode o servo do meu senhor falar com o meu senhor? Porque, quanto a mim, desde agora não resta força em mim, e nem fôlego ficou em mim.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף וַיִּגַּע־ בִּ֛י כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ way·yig·ga‘- bî kə·mar·’êh ’ā·ḏām way·ḥaz·zə·qê·nî
verses.literal: Again the one with the likeness of a man touched me and strengthened me
verses.literalPt: E aquele, que tinha aparência de um homem, tocou-me outra vez, e fortaleceu-me.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַל־ תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ־ חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַחֲזָ֑ק וּֽבְדַבְּר֤וֹ עִמִּי֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָאֹֽמְרָ֛ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’al- tî·rā ’îš- ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ šā·lō·wm lāḵ ḥă·zaq wa·ḥă·zāq ū·ḇə·ḏab·bə·rō ‘im·mî hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq·tî wā·’ō·mə·rāh yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·ḏō·nî kî ḥiz·zaq·tā·nî
verses.literal: Do not be afraid . . . you who are highly precious he said Peace be with you Be strong now be very strong As he spoke with me I was strengthened and said Speak my lord for you have strengthened me
verses.literalPt: E disse: Não temas, homem muito amado, paz seja contigo; anima-te, sim, anima-te. E, falando ele comigo, fiquei fortalecido, e disse: Fala, meu senhor, porque me fortaleceste.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲיָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לָמָּה־ בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־ שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַאֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְהִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר־ יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hă·yā·ḏa‘·tā lām·māh- bā·ṯî ’ê·le·ḵā wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·šūḇ lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im- śar pā·rās wa·’ă·nî yō·w·ṣê wə·hin·nêh śar- yā·wān bā
verses.literal: Do you know why I have come to you he said I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia and when I have gone forth behold the prince of Greece will come
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Sabes por que eu vim a ti? Agora, pois, tornarei a pelejar contra o príncipe dos persas; e, saindo eu, eis que virá o príncipe da Grécia.

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ אֶת־ הָרָשׁ֥וּם בִּכְתָ֖ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּי֙ עַל־ אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֥י אִם־ מִיכָאֵ֖ל שַׂרְכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl ’ag·gîḏ lə·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·rā·šūm biḵ·ṯāḇ ’ĕ·meṯ wə·’ên ’e·ḥāḏ miṯ·ḥaz·zêq ‘im·mî ‘al- ’êl·leh kî ’im- mî·ḵā·’êl śar·ḵem
verses.literal: But first I will tell you what is inscribed in the Book of Truth Yet no one has the courage to support me against these except . . . Michael your prince
verses.literalPt: Mas eu te declararei o que está registrado na escritura da verdade; e ninguém há que me anime contra aqueles, senão Miguel, vosso príncipe.
